name: Nameday (Slovak & Hungarian)
project_description:
NAMEDAY SK HU

 Name: nameday_skhu

Drupal: 8

 DESCRIPTION:

This module provides blocks for Slovakian and Hungarian namedays.

 Service usage:

use Drupal\nameday_skhu\NamedayClass;

 $nameday_service = \Drupal::service('nameday');

$nameday = $nameday_service->nameday('hu', '2017', '04', '10');

 INSTALLATION:

 Follow the drupal module installation document: [ https://www.drupal.org/docs/8/extending-drupal-8/installing-drupal-8-mo… ]

Enable the nameday block on block layout.
